packages.notes: A one-time bridge for devices old enough that their own update checker refuses newer updates outright (the update contains a file it may not change). Kept permanently on the feed, not just as a temporary latest, so this cannot recur for a device that missed the original window: install this first, then check again for anything newer.

Settings' sidebar is now grouped (Personalization/Network & devices/Accounts & privacy/System) and restyled with a frosted sidebar. Wallpapers grouped into categories. Update battery threshold lowered from 30% to 25%.
